**Brightwell Electric Kettle, 1.7 L — $29.90**

Auto shutoff and boil-dry protection suit a shared office where not everyone will watch the kettle. A full load boils in about four minutes, so a queue clears quickly. The gooseneck variant (0.9 L, $39.50) is designed for precision pouring into a coffee cone or teapot — fine for one person's routine but undersized and over-specialised for a department office. The standard kettle also supports pickup, avoiding a delivery wait if someone is passing the store.
